name: The Ghost
source:
"If the boss accepted you as you were, and you allowed him to do so, then likewise it's your duty to accept that truth."

Francis's bodyguard. He was also Yeung Kwun's bodyguard. His loyalty towards the Red Flower Society is absolute. He is leery of Yvet and keeps some secrets from her. He hired the Luk brothers to guard Yvet.

[From [url=http://www.rpgdl.org/rsl/en.html#character]official site[/url]]
